title: tuberaria variabilis var. eriocaulon
intro: Tuberaria variabilis var. eriocaulon, commonly known as Tuberaria, is a plant species in the family Cistaceae. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
